prompts.name: success
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: small desktop notification icon, part of a matching four-status icon family for mcp-node-notifier. Generate a single emerald green softly rounded square medallion with one bold white check mark centered on it. Polished restrained soft 3D style, matte enamel, very subtle bevel and dimensionality, straight-on front view, simple strong silhouette legible at 32 pixels. Square composition, medallion occupies 80 percent of frame with equal transparent margins. True transparent background including all corners; no background scene, no ground plane, no drop shadow outside the tile. Only the specified symbol, no words, no extra symbols, no logos, no watermark. Output a square PNG with alpha, ideally 256 by 256 pixels.
